title: SOLANA BAY
style: Photorealistic live-action feature film footage shot on an ARRI Alexa with anamorphic-free spherical cinema lenses, natural film grain, realistic motion blur, filmic contrast, true-to-life skin texture, restrained natural colour grade. Not a video game, not CGI, not animation.
negative: video game graphics, CGI look, cartoon, anime, plastic skin, oversaturated colours, heavy neon, text, subtitles, watermark, logos, brand badges, real car brand emblems, distorted faces, extra fingers, morphing

characters.marco: MARCO: a fictional 28-year-old man, short dark hair, light stubble, olive skin, athletic build, wearing a fitted black short-sleeve button shirt, dark slim jeans, black sunglasses, confident calm expression
characters.elena: ELENA: a fictional 26-year-old woman, shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair, warm tan skin, natural minimal make-up, wearing a cream silk top and a light linen jacket, small gold hoop earrings, confident relaxed expression
characters.car: THE CAR: an original fictional two-door mid-engine supercar in gloss black with smoked-glass windows, sharp angular body lines, thin LED headlight strips, no logos or badges

shots.prompt: Aerial drone shot slowly descending toward a fictional Miami-style coastal city at golden-hour sunset: glass skyscrapers, palm-lined boulevards, art-deco luxury hotels, a wide white-sand beach, turquoise ocean with sun reflections, a few supercars on the beachfront road. 24mm wide lens, smooth continuous descent.

Low-angle tracking shot: MARCO walks confidently toward THE CAR parked under the palm-tree porte-cochère of a premium art-deco beach hotel at golden hour. Warm wind moves his shirt, sunlight glints across the car's bodywork. 35mm lens, smooth gimbal move, shallow depth of field.

Cinematic close-up of MARCO's face as he lowers his black sunglasses slightly and looks off-camera, golden sunset reflected in the lenses, realistic skin pores and stubble. 50mm portrait lens, very shallow depth of field, gentle push-in.

Extreme close-up inside THE CAR's dark leather cockpit: a finger presses a glowing red engine start button, the digital dashboard lights up in sequence with soft amber and white glow. Macro detail, shallow depth of field.
Close-up of MARCO's hand gripping the leather steering wheel and pulling the carbon paddle shifter, the cabin subtly vibrating from the engine. Warm evening light through the windshield.
Exterior tracking shot from a camera car: THE CAR accelerates hard along a sunlit coastal road lined with palm trees, ocean on one side, golden-hour light, natural motion blur on the background.

Low-mounted bumper camera at night on wet city streets: THE CAR races ahead while two unmarked-style generic police SUVs with flashing red and blue light bars chase close behind, reflections of the lights streaking across the wet asphalt, city lights bokeh.

Side tracking shot in slow motion at night: THE CAR drifts sideways around a wet downtown corner, thick white tire smoke curling into the red and blue police lights, pedestrians on the far sidewalk step back safely. 120fps slow-motion look.

Fast aerial drone shot at night following THE CAR weaving through a grid of downtown streets, three police SUVs with flashing lights in pursuit far behind, skyscraper lights below, slight camera bank.
Camera follows directly behind THE CAR as it escapes onto an elevated coastal highway over the ocean at sunset, tail lights glowing, police lights fading far in the distance.

Inside THE CAR at sunset, side profile: ELENA in the passenger seat turns to MARCO and gives a small knowing smile, warm sunset light flaring through the window, MARCO driving in soft focus. 50mm lens.
Massive slow aerial pull-back over the whole fictional coastal city skyline at the last moment of sunset, deep orange sky, ocean reflections, a tiny pair of tail lights crossing a long bridge.
